thig5.5:1.1: aggiṃ candañ ca sūriyañ ca devatā ca namassi 'haṃ | nadītitthāni gantvāna udakaṃ oruhāmi 'haṃ. || ||
thig5.5:2.1: bahūvatasamādānā aḍḍhaṃ sīsassa olikhiṃ | chamāya seyyaṃ kappemi rattibhattaṃ na bhuñji 'haṃ. || ||
thig5.5:3.1: vibhūsamaṇḍanaratā nhāpanucchādanehi ca | upakāsiṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ kāmarāgena additā. || ||
thig5.5:4.1: tato saddhaṃ labhitvāna pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ | disvā kāyaṃ tathābhūtaṃ kāmarāgo samūhato. || ||
thig5.5:5.1: sabbe bhavā samucchinnā icchā ca patthanā pi ca | sabbayogavisaṃyuttā santiṃ pāpuṇiṃ cetaso. || || Nanduttarā
